note: Re-judged 2026-10-28 (independent auditor) after c532819895 added the resolver unit; the stub-cache units are byte-identical to the 2026-09-30 judgement and stand. Stub cache: an overlapping {B} replaces cached {A,B,C} with exactly {B} (no union, no remainder); AAAA of the same name and A of another name form no RRSet and stay whole. Resolver (lru.store, the path storeRRset uses): both arms of 'either ignore ... or discard the entire RRSet' are pinned by exact contents. A lower-ranked {192.0.2.9} over a live authoritative {.1,.2} leaves exactly {.1,.2} (ignore: catches merge and blind replace); an authoritative {.7} then leaves .7 alone (discard: catches merge and blind ignore). Negative: an AAAA put leaves the A RRset .7 in place. 'As appropriate' is decided by rank (RFC 2181 Section 5.4.1); equal or higher rank replaces.
